_about: Ceilings for npm run perf (synthetic) and npm run perf:obsidian (obsidian). Set 2026-10-04 from the Aegis wall on a 120Hz MacBook after the performance pass, with room for run-to-run noise of about 20%. 0.1.66 before the pass (results/obsidian-before.json) misses the obsidian set on hover-sweep, hover-column-walk, stage-steps and the layer count. The obsidian set is the release gate; the synthetic set is a quick smoke test, since a bare page does not pay Obsidian's per-element style cost.
